sections.content: When recounting a finished day, use simple sequencing words such as *primero* and *después* with the pretérito indefinido. The verb stays in the past while the connector shows the order of events.

items.spanish: Por la tarde fuimos al concierto.
items.english: In the afternoon we went to the concert.
Afterwards we had dinner at the market.

sections.content: *Primero* shortens to *primer* only right before a masculine singular noun, as in *el primer día*. Used on its own to sequence events, the way it's used here, it stays *primero*.
